newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION - LACROIX SIGNS FOR HARLEQUINS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION - LACROIX SIGNS FOR HARLEQUINS.

text.p: Former French international Thierry Lacroix became the latest foreigner to play club rugby in England when he signed for London club Harlequins on Friday.

The 29-year-old fly-half/centre, who was top points scorer in the 1995 World Cup before being axed from the French national team, has signed a 30-month contract which is worth an estimated 250,000 pounds ($422,000).
For the last two seasons he has played for top South African province Natal although he was unable to make the starting line-up for this year's Currie Cup final in October.

At Harlequins he will team up with two other ex-French internationals, Laurent Cabannes and Laurent Benezech. Lacroix, who scored 367 points in 38 internationals, will also be reunited with coach Andy Keast who was assistant coach at Natal in 1995.
Lacroix will make his first division debut against Wasps on January 5.
